properties.NAME: LITCHFIELD (Conn.)
properties.CHANGE: LITCHFIELD (Conn.) gained territory in Pennsylvania when Connecticut extended the western limit of its town of Westmoreland to the Fort Stanwix Indian Treaty line. LITCHFIELD overlapped NORTHAMPTON, NORTHUMBERLAND, and BEDFORD.
properties.CITATION: (Cappon, Petchenik, and Long, 17, 92; Conn. Col. Recs., 15:13)
